packageRules.description: Vuetify 3 is required by docs/requirements.md; no major upgrade without a decision.
TypeScript is capped by typescript-eslint support, see docs/adr/0001.

k0s versions carry the release number after '+' (v1.35.8+k0s.1).
Kubernetes catalogs keep one entry per minor: report patches of that minor separately.
